question: The left image shows the original cube stack made of equal-sized small cubes. Which of the options on the right can only be obtained by rotating the original cube stack? Please answer from options A, B, C, or D.
options: All three other options are incorrect
explanation:
Option C is correct because the cube stack can be obtained by rotating the original stack around the x-axis by 90 degrees.
Option A is incorrect because it is a vertically mirrored version of the original cube stack.
Option B is incorrect because it was obtained by removing one small cube from the original stack.
